quotes.quote: asks Codex, Cursor, and Gemini to review the code
quotes.excerpt: We've been using Coderabbit, great deal ($30/mo/dev flat) and finds a lot. I also built a skill I call `/meta-review` that asks Codex, Cursor, and Gemini to review the code (I use Claude Code). It always finds little things claude & I missed. Coderabbit just came out with their own PR review UI that's great for big PRs, it groups files together etc. https://www.coderabbit.ai/blog/introducing-atlas-the-first-ai-native
